countries.reasoning: China is the largest global steel producer and has a significant share in tool steel production; data based on global steel output from World Steel Association 2023 and industry reports indicating about 40% of tool steel production.
Germany is a top European steel producer with advanced specialty steel industries, including tool steel; data aligned with industry data from Steel Institute VDEh 2023.
Japan has a strong steel manufacturing sector focused on high-grade steels; estimates based on JIS and industry export data for tool steel grades in 2023.
US production of specialized tool steel reflects about 10% of global output; data from American Iron and Steel Institute 2023 and export records.
South Korea is a major steel producer with growing specialty steel output. Production estimates based on POSCO reports and industry publications for 2023.
